clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger sends Horde champions against the Witchwing coven in the northern Barrens. In the Dry Hills, the aim is to kill the flock’s front-line officers and break its chain of command.

After the first clashes with Witchwing raiders, Darsok Swiftdagger turns the offensive toward the harpies roosting in the Dry Hills. Horde scouts are sent after the Witchwing Slayers who lead the flock. These officers keep the lesser harpies in line and coordinate raids against Horde supply paths. Their deaths are critical to securing the northern approaches of the Barrens.

Witchwing Slayers lead through strength and dominance, and only the most vicious among them carry ornate rings that mark their authority within the matriarchy. Taking the rings proves the lieutenants are dead, disrupts the roost’s coordination, and sends the coven a clear message: attacks on Horde territory will meet decisive retribution.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hahaha, friend. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

This time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.
Make sure they die painfully, friend. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.
